description: Reference wall-clock durations for ASHFALL builds, gates, and audits. Checked by scripts/ci/timing-budget.py: a stage running 30% or less over its reference is tolerable; strictly more than default_tolerance_ratio (1.30 = 30% over) is flagged SUSPICIOUS and means investigate and optimize the test, not raise its budget. References are deliberately authored/recorded values from a quiet-system run, never an automatically-updated live ledger; a single noisy sample must not silently rebase them.

hardware.host: AMD Ryzen 5 7530U with Radeon Graphics (integrated GPU)
hardware.note: Static capture, not a timing measurement (required baseline field). Integrated GPU means frame-capture runs can land on llvmpipe software rendering, so record the renderer with every frame measurement. Wall-clock references were recorded under concurrent-session load (load average ~17-25) and are upper bounds.

docs_index_check.note: scripts/ci/generate-docs-index.py --check. Measured 215s before the plan corpora (docs/plans/**, 1472 files) were excluded; ~126s after; coordination ledgers (WORKTREE_OWNERSHIP.md, INTEGRATION_PLANS.md) also excluded. Load-sensitive — a concurrent dotnet/godot build can push this well past the reference.

build_core_tests.note: recorded from a measured run; re-record on a quiet system if load made it unrepresentative
